text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking through the park on my day
off. It's so peaceful today...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hit the deck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I flinch instinctively at the sound of Gold
Ship's voice.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You there! Don't just stand
around—trouble's coming! Danger!
Danger!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Darn, we can't stop now. This whole place
is about to blow...

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Cap'n Golshi, our advance is halted!
Permission to return to jungle
gym base!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, we'd have to cross the hot lava
sandbox to get back!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Just follow me! You too, Trainer! When
we're backed into a lava
corner, my
Goldy-Gold Kenpo can blast a way
through!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's nice to see Gold Ship playing with the
kids, but she's roped me
into the game
now...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Watch it, Trainer! That's a lava zone! Your
goose almost got roasted!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're missing all of the heavenly glory!
Don't think, feeeel! My
trainer should
know better!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, guys! Move ahead, I'll handle
the rear!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'll lead you all to victory... Cool, huh?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Wooow! You're the greatest, Cap'n Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship heroically leads the children
and me across the vast
sandbox. But then...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: C-Cap'n Golshi?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship has suddenly collapsed in the
sand!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Urk, looks like this is it for me... We were
almost home free, but they
got me...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen, you've got to go on without me...
You have to... live! ...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: No... Please wake up, Cap'n Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The scene of the crime was locked down,
and no murder weapon
found. Every single
suspect has an alibi...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
With nothing to go on, this case might go
cold. But don't you worry!
Crime never
escapes the great Sherlock Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Boys
text_block_list.text: It's really her! Sherlock Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hmm! Hmmm?! My bedazzling brain
cells of a 5,640,000 IQ
have just burst
into action!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The offender who shot me was... You, ya
dirty ol' rotten jerk head!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's pointing at me! What should I do...

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
You gotta say somethin' back or you'll
lose!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! You're Golshi's trainer for a
reason. Do something funny!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get it... I can't let her steer the ship all
the time. I need to be like
these kids and
go with the flow!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Agh, so this is your true form! Those thirty
purple tentacles sprouting
from your head
prove it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But what now? I can't take on this villain in
my current form! Everyone,
retreat!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... wheeze... How did you follow me all the way here?

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: What now... We're cornered!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, like I have any money... But I do
have this!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I am the great Umamusume goddess,
Golshaea. I see kind hearts in
need of aid
and bestow unto you my power.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
It's Golshaea. She only grants 100 miracles
a year!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it! You all sense it too, don't
you? It's the power of the
goddess!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's true! We can win this time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's flowing through us! Our combined
power level is over 5,640,000!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You'll never complete your evil plan,
villain! Prepare to taste... the
Golshi
Revenginator!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Collapse!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Justice has been... served!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: You did it! You're the awesomest, Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Another day where I'm not really sure what
happened... But it was
surprisingly fun to
go along with Gold Ship's goofy games.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Woooo! We pulled through okay!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We protected the park, caught the criminal, turned me into a god, and achieved world peace!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention the flowers bloomed, the
trees grew lush, and the
birds sang
beautifully! I even impress myself!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How could they not? I don't ever let
boredom strike, even for a split
second!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And you know, you weren't too bad at it
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think I got a little better at keeping up
with Gold Ship today!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I just remembered. I should finish those
Nazca lines I started drawing
in the school
garden!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You should come with! Meet in three secs!
Bye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It might be a while longer until I can fully
keep up though.
